justification: Inspected `byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/dynamic/scaffold/TypeWriter.java`, `byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/dynamic/scaffold/MethodRegistry.java`, and `byte-buddy-dep/src/test/java/net/bytebuddy/dynamic/scaffold/TypeWriterMethodPoolRecordTest.java`. `WithoutBody` is a small nested implementation with 3 fields and a narrow set of collaborators (`MethodDescription`, `MethodAttributeAppender`, `Visibility`, `MethodVisitor`, `Implementation.Context`, `AnnotationValueFilter.Factory`), and it has only one production caller (`MethodRegistry.ForAbstractMethod.assemble`) while the remaining references are test-only. That evidence does not show the high fan-in and fan-out expected for hub-like modularization.
